subject: Renewal + capacity upsize — PO, billing routing, and tax docs
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@skyline.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@skyline.ai>
Date: 2028-03-15T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + capacity increase — PO and billing contact

Hey Markus,

We’re ready to move forward on the renewal for Skyline AI. We’d like to increase our Dedicated capacity from 2 -> 10 instances for the 12-month term starting 2028-04-01. Finance asked me to confirm billing routing and send a formal PO.

High-level ask: can Redwood issue an amendment reflecting the new capacity and updated net terms of Net60? Our AP contact is Nina Patel (nina@skyline.ai). Please send W9 and any billing/contact fields AP will need. I can send a PO if that helps — I just wanted to align on the terms first.

Quick details you might need:
- Company: Skyline AI
- Tax ID: 12-3456789
- Billing contact: Nina Patel, Director of Finance, nina@skyline.ai, +1 415-555-0146

Thanks — looking to get this in the system before the end of the quarter.

—Liam
Liam O'Connor
Head of Platform Partnerships
Skyline AI
liam@skyline.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@skyline.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-15T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + capacity increase — PO and billing contact

Hi Liam — thanks for the clear summary.

We can absolutely support the upsize to 10 Dedicated instances and amend the renewal. Next steps I propose:
1) If you can attach the PO (or confirm PO number), we’ll intake it into finance.
2) We’ll prepare an amendment that reflects the new capacity and updated pricing; that will be routed for signature via DocuSign.
3) Rishi on Billing will confirm Net60 feasibility and any credit requirements — cc'd.
4) Please attach your W9/tax docs when you send the PO (helps speed payment processing).

For transparency on timing: if all docs arrive this week we can have the amendment routed within 2 business days. If AP needs invoices to be sent to a particular address or with specific PO line items, include that on the PO.

Looping in Marissa so CS is aware of the capacity increase and can schedule the capacity ramp.

Regards,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com

From: Nina Patel <nina@skyline.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@skyline.ai>, Skyline AP <ap@skyline.ai>
Date: 2028-03-16T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Skyline PO 20280315 and W9 attached

Markus / Rishi — attaching the formal PO and our W9 as requested.

Attachments: Skyline_PO_20280315.pdf (PO #SKY-2028-0315), Skyline_W9_20280315.pdf

Billing details to include on invoices:
- Bill to: Skyline AI, 220 Montgomery St, San Francisco, CA 94104
- Attention: Nina Patel, Director of Finance
- AP email for invoices: ap@skyline.ai
- Net terms requested: Net60 (preferred)

We appreciate if Redwood can accept Net60 for the renewal. If credit is required, let me know the economist/credit form to complete — we can turn it around quickly.

Thanks,
Nina Patel
Director, Finance
Skyline AI

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@skyline.ai>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-03-16T12:36:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Skyline PO 20280315 and W9 attached

Thanks for the PO and W9, Nina — that helps. A few items from Billing: 

- We can provisionally update the invoice routing to ap@skyline.ai and set the bill-to address you provided.
- Net60 is acceptable pending a brief credit review. To complete that we need a filled credit application; I’ve attached Redwood_Credit_App.pdf. If you return that within 48 hours we’ll finalize Net60 for the term start date.
- As a contingency for provisioning, we can issue the first invoice on Net30 while the credit application is processed; subsequent invoices would switch to Net60 once credit is approved. If that is unacceptable, confirm and we’ll escalate for an exception with finance leadership.

Please also confirm the PO line item structure — currently we have a single line for "Dedicated capacity (monthly)" but if AP needs per-instance or per-seat lines, indicate on the PO.

Attachment: Redwood_Credit_App.pdf (fillable)

Cheers,
Rishi Malhotra
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com

From: Liam O'Connor <liam@skyline.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@skyline.ai>, Skyline AP <ap@skyline.ai>
Date: 2028-03-18T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Skyline PO 20280315 and W9 attached

Rishi — attached the completed credit app and the signed amendment link below. We accepted the contingency of first invoice Net30 while credit completes, that’s fine.

Attachments: Skyline_Credit_App_filled.pdf (attached inline), Signed_Amendment_20280320.pdf (DocuSign link below)

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/signed/0a1b2c3d4e
PO: SKY-2028-0315 (please include this on every invoice)

Please confirm once the amendment is countersigned and the billing routing is updated.

—Liam

From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina@skyline.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Liam O'Connor <liam@skyline.ai>
Date: 2028-03-20T16:02:00-07:00
Subject: Final: countersigned amendment + invoice routing confirmed

Nina/Liam — thanks, received the signed amendment via DocuSign and the completed credit app. 

Confirmed actions:
- Amendment signed and archived (DocuSign link: https://app.docusign.com/signed/0a1b2c3d4e).
- Billing has updated routing: invoices will be emailed to ap@skyline.ai and will reference PO SKY-2028-0315.
- Invoice cadence: monthly in arrears. First invoice will be issued 2028-05-01 for April usage; Rishi flagged that the first invoice will be Net30 while credit review completes, subsequent invoices will be Net60 once approved.
- CS (Marissa) will schedule the capacity ramp the week of 2028-04-01.

Attachments: Invoice_Schedule_Q2_2028.pdf (invoice dates and amounts)

If you’d like an alternate routing (accounting system integration / Ariba) let me know and we’ll loop in Partnerships. Otherwise we’ll proceed as above.

Best,
Markus Klein
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
markus@redwood.com
